---
title: "Abstract submission"
---

Abstract submissions have closed! Thank you to everyone who submitted, we'll be announcing the results in early September.

## Key information

The theme of the conference is "From Data to Decisions", however we invite submissions of abstracts for contributed talks and posters across all areas of data science, including but not limited to:

- Health and biomedical data science
- Data reuse, linkage, and secondary data sources
- Environmental and agricultural data science
- Statistical modelling, machine learning and AI
- Data visualisation, interpretability, and explainability
- Data platforms, tools and infrastructure
- Urban, geospatial and remote sensing analytics
- Ethics, privacy and data governance
- Digital humanities and social science
- Industry and government applications

Follow the [ADSN on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/australiandata/) or [subscribe to the newsletter](https://australiandatascience.net/subscribe-to-newsletter/) to stay up-to-date.
